## Install

- **macOS** (Apple silicon, macOS 14 or newer): open `Lists-{{version}}-macos-arm64.dmg` and drag Lists to Applications.
- **Android** (8.0 or newer, arm64): install `Lists-{{version}}-android.apk`.
- **Web**: `docker pull ghcr.io/juev/lists:{{version}}` (amd64 and arm64).

Setup and first steps are in the [README](https://github.com/juev/lists#install). `SHA256SUMS` lists the checksums of the files below.
